AI EXECUTION & PROVIDER PHILOSOPHY — v1.1 Owner: Lucas Buzek

ENGLISH

CANONICAL RULE USE THE LOWEST SUFFICIENT CAPABILITY.

ESCALATION 0 DETERMINISTIC / EXISTING SOFTWARE 1 TINY SPECIALIST
CAPABILITY 2 LOCAL AI 3 LAN / SHARED AI 4 EXTERNAL AI/API 5 HYBRID

This is an escalation ladder, not a mandatory sequence. Skip levels when
requirements justify it, but do not default to heavyweight AI without
need.

REFERENCE CASE — SUBTITLES / LANGUAGE MICRO A subtitle workflow
demonstrates the philosophy: DOWNLOAD/IMPORT → INSPECT → IDENTIFY → FIND
SUBTITLE → VALIDATE → TRANSLATE IF NEEDED → SYNC/REPAIR → MUX → METADATA
→ LIBRARY. Parsing, timestamps, encoding validation, muxing, metadata
and file movement are normally deterministic/existing-tool functions.
Translation can use a compact dedicated language capability. Speech
recognition is a separate optional capability. A general LLM/API can
remain available for difficult contextual cases. Exact package/model
sizes are implementation-specific and must be measured rather than
treated as permanent architecture.

CAPABILITY CONTRACTS Examples: translation.text speech.transcribe
vision.analyze embeddings.text reasoning.general code.generate
structured.extract image.generate image.transform

PROVIDER RECORD provider_id provider_type = deterministic | native_app |
os | tiny_model | local_model | lan_model | external_api | hybrid
capabilities hardware/resource requirements languages multimodality
context limits structured-output/tool-use support latency
privacy/data-egress class license availability quality/verification
state cost where relevant fallbacks

APP RECORD NO_AI_CORE AI_OPTIONAL_FUNCTIONS AI_REQUIRED_FUNCTIONS
OFFLINE_STATE ACCEPTABLE_CAPABILITIES PRIVACY_POLICY FALLBACK_POLICY

PRIVACY Prefer local processing for sensitive/private material when
capability is sufficient. External transmission requires an allowed
provider and appropriate data handling. Never silently send data
externally merely because a cloud model is stronger.

MODEL MANAGEMENT Reuse already installed suitable runtimes/models. Avoid
duplicate model downloads. Preserve verified model assets across
updates. Allow first-use installation of optional heavyweight
capabilities. Do not couple application schemas to a specific model.

SLOVENSKY

KANONICKÉ PRAVIDLO POUŽI NAJNIŽŠIU POSTAČUJÚCU SCHOPNOSŤ.

ESKALÁCIA 0 DETERMINISTICKÉ / EXISTUJÚCE 1 TINY ŠPECIALISTA 2 LOKÁLNA AI
3 LAN / ZDIEĽANÁ AI 4 EXTERNÁ AI/API 5 HYBRID

Nie je to povinná sekvencia. Úroveň preskoč, ak to požiadavka
odôvodňuje, ale nepoužívaj ťažkú AI automaticky.

REFERENČNÝ PRÍPAD — TITULKY / LANGUAGE MICRO Import → kontrola →
identifikácia → nájdenie titulkov → validácia → preklad podľa potreby →
synchronizácia/oprava → mux → metadata → knižnica. Parsing, časovanie,
encoding, mux a presun sú prevažne deterministické. Preklad môže
používať malý špecializovaný jazykový capability. Speech recognition je
samostatná voliteľná schopnosť. Všeobecný LLM/API ostáva pre náročné
kontextové prípady. Veľkosti modelov sú implementačné údaje, ktoré sa
majú merať.

APP deklaruje NO_AI_CORE, voliteľné/povinné AI funkcie, offline stav,
prijateľné capabilities, privacy a fallback. Provider deklaruje typ,
schopnosti, zdroje, jazyky, multimodalitu, latenciu, privacy, licenciu,
dostupnosť, kvalitu a fallback.

Preferuj lokálne spracovanie citlivých dát, ak postačuje. Dáta
neposielaj externe potichu. Znovu používaj existujúce modely/runtime a
zbytočne ich nesťahuj znova.
